_comment: English locale for Wordle. Keys (left) are fixed; translate only the values (right). Keep every {placeholder} verbatim, and keep the feedback letters G/Y/X unchanged (they are the game's per-letter markers).

_slots.{view}: Neutral rendered letters + G/Y/X feedback (do not translate)

prompt.intro:
You are Playing Wordle.
A secret {word_length}-letter word has been chosen. You have {num_guesses} attempts to guess it.
For each guess, wrap your word in square brackets (e.g., '[apple]').
Feedback for each letter will be given as follows:
  - G (green): correct letter in the correct position
  - Y (yellow): letter exists in the word but in the wrong position
  - X (wrong): letter is not in the word
Enter your guess to begin.

invalid.wrong_format: You tried submitting a word in the wrong format. Please make sure to use squared brackets.
invalid.wrong_length: Your word must be exactly {word_length} letters.
invalid.already_guessed: You have already guessed '{word}' before. Please try a different word.

feedback.submitted:
You submitted [{word}].
Feedback:
{view}
You have {guesses_left} guesses left.

outcome.win: Congratulations! You guessed the word correctly!
outcome.turn_limit:
The turn limit has been reached. You didn't guess the word, but your best guess matched {pct}% of the letters in the correct positions.
The secret word was: **{secret}**.
